definitions.explanation: An intuitive sense beyond the five physical senses — the ability to perceive or know something without conscious reasoning. Similar to English 'sixth sense.'

examples.japanese: {第六感|だいろっかん}が{働|はたら}いた。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{第六感|だいろっかん}が{鋭|するど}い{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: She is a person with keen intuition.

examples.japanese: {第六感|だいろっかん}で{何|なに}か{良|よ}くないことが{起|お}こりそうな{気|き}がした。
examples.english: My gut feeling told me something bad was about to happen.

notes:
USAGE:
Used the same way as "sixth sense" in English. Often appears with {働|はたら}く (to work, to kick in) or {鋭|するど}い (sharp, keen).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {第六感|だいろっかん}が{働|はたら}く (one's sixth sense kicks in)
- {第六感|だいろっかん}が{鋭|するど}い (to have keen intuition)
- {第六感|だいろっかん}で{感|かん}じる (to sense with one's sixth sense)

RELATED WORDS:
- {直感|ちょっかん} (intuition — more commonly used in everyday speech)
- {勘|かん} (intuition, hunch — more casual)
